verdict: GBP activity is real, but paid channels are offline and calls remain low.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Google Business Profiles were the only active channel, generating 170 total actions — including 14 calls, 113 direction requests, and 43 website clicks across three locations. No paid advertising ran on Meta or Google Ads during this period, which means no paid leads were captured; the profiles are carrying the full load. Of the people who found you on Google, most navigated to your locations rather than calling — 66% of all actions were direction requests, and call rates peaked at just 1.36%, pointing to a friction point between profile visitors and actual phone contact. We're reviewing the call-to-action prominence and phone number placement across all three profiles to address this directly. With paid campaigns reactivated alongside those profile fixes, you should see both lead volume and call rates improve in the next period.
